'''Ch'hedt''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Jawa/Legends|Jawa]] who lived on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]]. During the war the Jawa worked in the [[Dune Sea/Legends|Dune Sea]] and sold various goods that could be used by a number of crafting professions.
